protocol.training: at least a month of healthy readings before the month: the whole previous month, reached back a week at a time to at most 92 days and never before the last maintenance; standstill, the 12 h warm-up after a restart and every flagged day left out; rows trimmed as in the engine
protocol.frozen: the month's model never learns from the month itself
protocol.check: the day's mean of actual minus predicted, over running readings outside the warm-up, at least 36 of them; hot above the tolerance, cold below minus it
protocol.call_out: a run of consecutive hot days, dispatched at the end of its first day
protocol.confirmed_fault: a hot day inside a documented anomaly span (the stand-in for an inspection); the model then stays frozen until maintenance
protocol.false_alarm: a hot day outside any anomaly span: the stand-in inspection clears it, and the day is never trained on
protocol.maintenance: a restart after 3 days or more without running; the model is blank until a new month of healthy data exists
protocol.restart: the first running reading after 6 h without running
protocol.fixed_limit: 80 C held for an hour, for comparison
protocol.forecast: ERA5 plus a stated error, a bias per day and noise per hour, whose sigma is 1 a day ahead rising to 2.5 a week ahead (m/s for wind, K for temperature); power from the turbine's own power curve against ERA5 wind; the model in force when the forecast is issued
protocol.siblings: the turbine minus its siblings' median at the same moment, power within 0.1 of rated; the normal gap learned from the model's training window, per 45-degree ERA5 wind sector ('direction') or overall; the daily median smoothed over 5 days

gearbox_rule.rule: at least 2 of the 4 gearbox sensors hotter than the tolerance on the same day
